jobText:
Associate Cloud Engineer (New Graduate) — Halberd Managed Services

About us
Halberd Managed Services runs AWS environments for about 200 mid-size companies, from regional credit unions to e-commerce brands. Our engineers design, automate, and support those environments around the clock, and our new-graduate program pairs every associate with a senior engineer for their first year.

About the role
As an Associate Cloud Engineer you will join a customer pod and help build serverless applications with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB, write infrastructure as code in Terraform and CloudFormation, and troubleshoot customer networking issues across VPCs and VPNs. You will rotate through our support queue, where you will triage tickets, communicate clearly with customer IT teams, and document fixes in our knowledge base. Over time you will take ownership of small customer projects end to end.

You might be a fit if you have
- A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience
- Coursework or project experience with AWS, especially serverless services
- Programming experience in Python or JavaScript
- Comfort troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and user issues
- An AWS certification (Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect – Associate) is a plus
- Experience with Terraform, Docker, or Kubernetes is a plus

Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on day one
- 401(k) with a 4% company match
- $1,500 annual learning budget plus paid AWS certification exams
- 20 days of paid time off and 10 company holidays
- Hybrid schedule: three days a week in our Fargo office

Halberd is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
